purpose: Frozen development comparison, all final models; not fresh held-out evaluation

success_criteria.criterion: For primary both arm, lower endpoints of paired training-seed t95 intervals versus BOTH controls must exceed zero; intersection requirement. n=5 training seeds, df=4. Evaluation episodes shared blocks.
success_criteria.secondary: All other arm/control and risk-minus-zero/both-minus-risk intervals descriptive; no selecting winner after results.
success_criteria.reporting: All 15 final checkpoints, every episode and tail loss. No score changes, dropped models or best-checkpoint selection.
success_criteria.runtime: All arms and baselines under same frozen Python 3.11/NumPy 1.26/Torch 2.2 rebuilt-scorer profile.

evaluation_note: 8221-8252 previously used development episodes; none claimed unused. Fixed Discovery Red. No fresh final/general-attacker claim.
source_commit: Pinned at packaging after publishing source; see private pilot.json
compatibility_candidate: Python 3.11 / NumPy 1.26.4 / SciPy 1.12.0 / Torch 2.2.0; refit on unchanged original dataset
